facts.text: Mountain Brook was developed in 1929 by real‑estate businessman Robert Jemison Jr. as a suburb of Birmingham along Red Mountain and Shades Mountain.
The city’s name comes from a local Mountain Brook Store in Blount County, according to one account.
Mountain Brook is home to the first office park in the U.S., built in 1955, featuring ample free parking and low‑profile buildings surrounded by landscaped grounds.

The city’s streets were designed by landscape architect Warren H. Manning, who called for estate‑sized lots and three picturesque villages: English Village, Mountain Brook Village, and Crestline Village.
Mountain Brook preserves 92.03% tree cover, one of the highest ratios in the nation, thanks to its forested residential sections like Cherokee Bend and Brookwood Forest.
Actress Courteney Cox was born and raised in Mountain Brook, making the city the hometown of a Hollywood star.
